verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a government service with online filing and payment portals, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only an interactive eSystems login gating Webfile, a keyless read-only open-data rail, and no OpenAPI spec. Nothing documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
